name: AZ-COM MARUWA Holdings Inc.
summary: AZ-COM MARUWA Holdings Inc. provides logistics services in Japan. The company's 3PL services include low and normal temperature food, pharmaceutical and medical, and room temperature logistics services. It also involved in the transportation, storage to disposal of documents; and provision of document management, warehousing, and real estate leasing supporting services. The company was formerly known as Maruwa Unyu Kikan Co.,Ltd. AZ-COM MARUWA Holdings Inc. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Yoshikawa, Japan.
